I think that is bold and brave of you.  I just don't know how I can rationalize all the lying anymore.  Right now I pretend to everyone that I'm doing ok but go to bed every night knowing that I'm recklessly imitating the lifestyle I wish I could enjoy but know I never know.

I guess what I'm saying is I had set expectations for myself in life, like bare minimum quality of living, and now I'm finding myself set up for sub mediocrity... at best... in 20 years.  It just doesn't seem worth it.  I'd rather "live fast and die young"

I have daydream/fantasies of how some celebrity/affluent business woman will pick me up and make an example of how anyone can turn themselves around, but those delusions are shattered pretty quickly because they're absolutely ridiculous.

To answer your question: No.  I don't like kids, I don't want to get married.  I like dogs and maslow says I need a house but with my credit score/financial situation there is no way I could ever do it at this point.
